payload.stem: A rigid $4\text{ L}$ flask holds $\mathrm{Ar}$(g) at $2\text{ atm}$, and a second rigid $1\text{ L}$ flask holds $\mathrm{CH_{4}}$(g) at $1.5\text{ atm}$.
